result:
The readings are unambiguous for the quarter ending 30 April: open 1,240,000, weighted 412,000, committed 180,000.

How much of that would I put my name to? The committed figure, and not much past it. There is no forecast value on the Weserbund deal — it carries no amount at all — so six of the seven are priced and the seventh is simply absent from every number above. I cannot give you a reason to trust the weighted line beyond that.
